context: A teacher walks a uni student through an agriculture policy paper
purpose: Teach: 肥料/農産物/発動/保安/勤労/教徒/陳述/軍人

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 論文、肥料政策と農産物の流通を扱うんですね。
lines.en: Your paper covers fertilizer policy and agricultural product distribution, doesn't it.
lines.style: Warm, genuinely interested. Opening with steady eye contact. Leaning in slightly, as if inviting him into a real conversation rather than conducting a review.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。緊急時の発動条件、保安基準も論じます。
lines.en: Yes. And we're also discussing the emergency-activation conditions and safety standards.
lines.style: Careful, precise. Speaking as though each word has been chosen. Slight nervous energy beneath—wanting to show he's thought this through. Steady pace, no rushes.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 勤労意欲の低下が農村部で目立ちますね。
lines.en: The decline in work motivation really does stand out in rural areas.
lines.style: Nodding approval as she speaks. Thoughtful, drawing him out. Not lecturing—recognizing something he's noticed too. Slight upward lilt on the observation, inviting his response.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 宗教教徒の互助システムが、歴史的に支えになった例もあります。
lines.en: Historical mutual-aid systems among religious communities provided real structural support in those places.
lines.style: Gaining confidence as he moves into his research. Speaking clearly, with the quiet conviction of having read the sources. No flourish—just laying the insight down.

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: 証人の陳述、丁寧に引用してください。
lines.en: Make sure you cite the witness testimony carefully and precisely.
lines.style: Gentle but firm. The instruction of someone who knows where sloppy citation leads. Not a command—a standard, held steady. Warm enough that he hears it as caring.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 退役軍人のインタビューも、補足資料に入れます。
lines.en: I'm including retired soldiers' interviews in the supplementary materials as well.
lines.style: Nodding as he speaks, showing he's already integrated the feedback. Small, genuine smile—he came prepared. Voice carries the quiet satisfaction of having done the work thoroughly.
